title: Windows npm shim invocation through cmd.exe
failure_signature: Python CreateProcess receives access denied when asked to execute the extensionless Codex npm shim directly.
trigger_preconditions: A Python validator must verify a Windows npm-installed CLI version.
candidate_workaround: Invoke codex through cmd.exe /d /c so Windows resolves the npm command shim correctly.
recurrence_guard: Use an explicit Windows command interpreter for .cmd or extensionless npm shims inside subprocess validators.
rollback: Retain the crashed canonical attempt with zero credit and do not rerun the broad validator until the isolated command succeeds.
scope_boundary: CLI version subprocess only; it does not validate other canonical checks or launch any CLI sibling.
